name: io.github.clockblocker/prinfer
title: prinfer
description: TypeScript inferred types, completions and type errors for AI coding agents

environmentVariables.name: PRINFER_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Backend for the hover and diagnostics tools. Use typescript6 if the native TypeScript 7 backend fails in your project.

environmentVariables.name: PRINFER_INCLUDE_TIMING
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 or true to add type-resolution timing to every hover result.
